static_traits.name: Lu Kai
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues from her negative views of Student behavior; having a close friend to confide in
static_traits.medical_history: without marked medical history; not yet received psychotherapy before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperativeness; self-reporting 'somewhat anxious', overall Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: I often hold negative thoughts about students, anticipating they will misbehave and learn nothing in situations like off-campus activities. These negative thoughts appeared during my teaching career and became more prominent recently; Stress significantly increasing when handling large groups of students or new activities, the problem developing to affect my teaching style and classroom enjoyment. I mainly have these negative thoughts during off-campus activities or Group projects, and though trying to stay positive and focus on tasks, struggle to overcome these negative expectations.
basic_info.core_demands: These negative thoughts are affecting my teaching effectiveness and overall job satisfaction, so I decided to seek counseling, hoping to overcome these negative thoughts and improve my teaching effectiveness and overall job satisfaction.
growth_experiences: In multiple past off-campus activities and large-group projects, a few students were undisciplined, making her Stress significantly increasing when facing large student groups, gradually forming negative Anticipations of activities 'turning into disasters'.

Similar negative thoughts repeatedly appearing throughout her teaching career (especially when handling large groups), though not yet received psychotherapy, these experiences gradually accumulating and affecting her teaching style, relationships with colleagues, and relaxation and enjoyment outside Work.

core_beliefs: Large events usually get out of control and end badly
I am not competent enough to manage large groups of students

special_situations.event: Tomorrow will take the fifth-grade class on an off-campus activity
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If students are noisy or inattentive during activities, it means they learn nothing, the activity is a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Becomes stricter and less patient before and after activities, in an attempt to control the situation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will be noisy, unruly, learning nothing at all

special_situations.event: Facing large student groups or new activities (e.g. Group projects)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Large groups are harder to manage, slight hiccups will spiral out of control
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pre-setting strict rules, strongly controlling the process

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Some problems appearing means overall failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Highly tense in activities and strictly managed
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one will listen, the whole activity will be a mess

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be a recognized Teacher who maintains order effectively, with students Learning and cooperating in activities
core_conflict.fear: Fearing activities going out of control and failing, being negated by others and losing control
defense_goal: Gains a sense of control and safety by presupposing the worst outcome and staying strict

object_relations.self_representation: A tense Teacher in large-group activities needing strong control
object_relations.object_representation: A student group prone to chaos, disobedient

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing off-campus activities or situations requiring managing large student groups
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Presetting students as 'will lose control and not learn', treating activities as doomed to fail
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes discipline and rules in advance, serious and strongly directive in tone, reducing open interaction to maintain a sense of control.

manifestations: Negative Anticipation of teaching activities weakening the joy and satisfaction she gets from Work
Finds it harder to relax and enjoy outside work

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Repeatedly asserting in counseling students will be 'noisy, not learning', externalizing activity Anxiety as students' Anticipated behavior
Before activities, presets negative outcomes and adjusts behavior accordingly (stricter, less patient)

exception_events.target_problem: When organizing off-campus activities, the client usually catastrophically anticipates students losing control, thus becoming highly Anxious before and after activities and adopting overly strict management, struggling to enjoy teaching.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Last week at the museum off-campus activity, despite prior worries, only a few minor issues actually appeared, overall smooth, students participating and Learning, the result markedly better than Anticipated, she felt some relief in the moment.
exception_events.reason: Clues: positive experience of past smooth activities; this time's actual on-site feedback mismatching Anticipation, providing corrective evidence, thus weakening catastrophic predictions.

positive_force: Having multiple past smooth activities' positive experiences (students participating and Learning)
Can reduce falling into negative thoughts by focusing on tasks (self-reported that this strategy helps)
Proactively seeking professional help, having Reflection and willingness to change
negative_force: Tendency to negate positive experiences (focusing more on potential problems)
Markedly elevated stress in large-group or new-activity situations, prone to negative Anticipation

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety and catastrophic negative Anticipation when facing large groups or off-campus activities, becoming overly strict and impatient in classroom management
antecedent: Situations requiring managing many students simultaneously
target_behavior.core_reason: Past experiences of some students being undisciplined in off-campus activities forming catastrophic cognitions of large groups 'inevitably losing control' and a strong pursuit of control
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncontrollable risks and Anxiety, gaining safety through reinforced control
target_behavior.consequence: Teaching effectiveness affected, Tense relationships with colleagues, decreased enjoyment of Work and life
